notes.title: Demo 0.0.1 hotfixes
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Alt+Ente[/b]r now switches between windowed mode and fullscreen mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alt+F4[/b] now closes the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees in Dark Forest now sometimes drop Grass.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees in Dark Forest now sometimes drop... Food, sort of![/p][/*][*][p]Dark Forest now sometimes spawn white mushrooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Animals now spawn in Dark Forest biome.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Broken save files should be skipped now from loading instead of crashing the game.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Remove assertion message box that allowed to continue executing the game. Which could've caused a lot of bad things![/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Made hoes flavor text more useful.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Slingshot mechanics converted to bow mechanics for now.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Bow mechanics now require you to charge the shot.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Spear mechanics now require you to charge the attack. Still no good animation tho![/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Attacking with a spear now locks your movement.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Save files now show their version if they are outdated. Auto-conversion will occur on loading, so everything should be fine.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Fix playtime calculation for save files. Which reset playtimes on all the save files, o7[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Cartography technologies now have small descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) You can now cook Raw Chicken in the Furnace.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) You can't build on top of the player anymore. Hopefully.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Fixed icon size for belts.[/p][/*][*][p](FIX) Player now starves until reaching 1hp, no more exploding at 0 hp when trying to mine some material. Which was fun![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo is Out!
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3117640"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This is mainly a stability test to find bugs, test out early game progression, core gameplay mechanics, etc.[/p][p]There are 1-2 hours of chill gameplay currently, so it will give you a general vibe of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We plan to update the demo for quite a bit of time, so a lot more content and features "Coming Soon (tm)".[/p][p]But we need to focus on polish and stability first, even though I really want to start working on fishing, settlements and dungeons already.[/p][p][/p][p]Want to share you feedback, report bugs or give us ideas? Consider joining our [url="https://discord.gg/HFCSUBHBuG"][b]Discord[/b][/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Also, don't forget to wishlist the game <3[/p][p][/p][p]- [i]abstract_panic[/i][/p]
